desc: The MESE method involves multiple spin echo images acquired at different echo times and is primarily used for T2 mapping. Please note that this suffix is not intended for the logical grouping of images acquired using an Echo Planar Imaging (EPI) readout. Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
